metadata.raw_content:
"**Test 3**"  
  
Tabata Squat  
Max reps of Muscle-ups in 4 minutes  
  
The Tabata interval is 20 seconds of work followed by 10 seconds of rest for 8 intervals. Tabata score is the least number of reps performed in any of the eight intervals. Begin time for muscle-ups immediately after the last 10 second rest interval. Test score equals Tabata score multiplied by number of muscle-ups completed.   
  
[Graham Holmberg](http://www.roguecolumbus.com/) 616 (22 x 28), [Kristan Clever](http://www.valleycrossfit.com/) 575 (25 x 23), [James Hobart](http://www.crossfitboston.com/) 528 (22 x 24), [Greg Amundson](http://crossfitamundson.com/) 525 (21 x 25), [Heather Bergeron](http://crossfitnewengland.com/)<strike>368</strike> (<strike>23</strike> x 16). Post score to comments.  
  
See "[How Fit Are You?](http://journal.crossfit.com/2003/04/how-fit-are-you-by-greg-glassm.tpl)" - [[pdf](http://library.crossfit.com/free/pdf/08_03_How_Fit_Are_You.pdf)]
